responsibility: Implements the post-register-allocation redundant extension elimination pass that looks for zero/sign/other extension insns whose effect can be merged into all reaching hard-register definitions. Using MIR and DU/UD dataflow chains, it identifies extension candidates, rewrites defining insns or conditional-move chains into wider forms when target recognition allows, emits compensating copies when source and destination registers differ, and deletes the now-redundant extension in the "ree" RTL pass.
